title: Government Engineering Jobs: ESE, SSC JE, TGPSC and PSUs
summary: This path covers the main routes into government engineering jobs: UPSC Engineering Services, SSC Junior Engineer, Telangana Public Service Commission (TGPSC) posts and PSU jobs through GATE. It suits students who want stable public-sector work and can study steadily for months.
outcomes: Group A engineer through UPSC Engineering Services
Junior Engineer in central government departments
Assistant Executive Engineer or similar state posts
Engineer or Executive Trainee in a PSU

nodes.title: Know the exams and which fit your branch
nodes.summary: UPSC ESE covers Civil, Mechanical, Electrical and Electronics & Telecommunication. SSC JE covers Civil, Mechanical and Electrical. Some PSUs, such as POWERGRID, also hire Computer Science graduates through GATE. Read each notice for eligibility.
nodes.proof: A table of the exams you are eligible for, with the official notice link for each.

nodes.title: Make one study plan around the official calendars
nodes.summary: GATE, ESE and SSC JE test many of the same core subjects, so one plan can cover several exams. Build your weekly plan around the official exam calendars and revise it when new notices come out.
nodes.proof: A written week-by-week plan that maps each syllabus topic to the exams it serves.

nodes.title: Core engineering subjects and engineering maths
nodes.summary: Study your branch's core subjects and engineering mathematics topic by topic, using the official syllabus of each exam as your checklist. Free NPTEL courses from IIT faculty help with concepts.

resources.title: GATE 2027 test papers and syllabus – IIT Madras

nodes.proof: Short notes per syllabus topic plus a formula sheet you can revise in one hour.

sources.title: GATE 2027 test papers and syllabus – IIT Madras

nodes.title: General studies and engineering aptitude
nodes.summary: The ESE general paper covers current issues, logical reasoning, engineering maths, standards and quality, project management and ethics in engineering. Read the newspaper daily and practise reasoning questions.
nodes.proof: Your scores on three past ESE general studies papers, solved under time limits.

nodes.title: Previous papers and mock test series
nodes.summary: Solve official previous papers for each exam under timed conditions. UPSC posts past ESE preliminary and main papers, and the GATE site has past GATE papers. Keep a mistake log and revisit weak topics.

resources.title: Previous year question papers (filter: Engineering Services) – UPSC

nodes.proof: A mistake log covering at least fifteen timed past papers, with scores improving over time.

nodes.title: GATE for PSU jobs
nodes.summary: PSUs such as NTPC, POWERGRID, IndianOil and ONGC shortlist using GATE scores, then hold group discussions, interviews or other tests. Some accept only that year's GATE score, so read each advertisement on the PSU's careers page.
nodes.proof: A list of PSUs hiring in your GATE paper, with each advertisement link and its selection steps.

nodes.title: UPSC Engineering Services Examination
nodes.summary: ESE has a preliminary stage (a general studies and engineering aptitude paper plus a branch paper) and a main stage with conventional branch papers. Read the full notice for the scheme, eligibility and later stages.
nodes.proof: Five past ESE main answers in your branch, written by hand in the time allowed and self-checked.

nodes.title: SSC Junior Engineer (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical)
nodes.summary: SSC JE recruits Junior Engineers for departments such as CPWD and the Central Water Commission through two computer-based papers. Qualifications and age limits differ by post, so check the notice.
nodes.proof: Scores on three full timed practice papers in the SSC JE pattern, with a mistake log.

nodes.title: Telangana state posts through TGPSC
nodes.summary: The Telangana Public Service Commission (TGPSC, earlier TSPSC) recruits for state engineering posts such as Assistant Executive Engineer. Each notification has its own syllabus, so follow the official notifications page.
nodes.proof: A syllabus checklist for one TGPSC engineering notification, mapped to your existing notes.

nodes.title: Group discussion and interview preparation
nodes.summary: PSUs such as NTPC and POWERGRID add a group discussion and a personal interview after the GATE shortlist. Practise explaining your final-year project, core basics and current issues clearly and calmly.

resources.title: Employment Communication: A Lab-based Course – NPTEL

nodes.proof: Recordings of two mock interviews and two mock group discussions, with feedback you acted on.
